programme: ETH MSc Computational Science and Engineering
notice: Starter thresholds only; verify against the individual binding regulations and admission conditions. Do not treat as an official academic audit.

requirements.notice: Scientific Works in Mathematics or Physics must be completed at BSc or MSc level; do not count ECTS twice.

provenance.text: Two core courses; four lectures and a seminar; at least two electives. Minimum credit figures apply per category. Achievements beyond the maximum 130 degree credit points can be listed separately. Reviewed 2026-11-10; 130 ECTS is warning-only in MasterPlan.
Case Studies Seminar yields three ECTS credits and must be attended and passed twice.
At least one semester project is required, worth 8 credits. Additional semester projects are counted as electives.

createdBy: manual-starter; replace via validated agent output

conditions: Only modules listed as Core Courses, not the programme electives.
No credit reuse from a Bachelor degree.
No double counting and subject to applicable personal regulations.
electiveEligibility.notice: Eligibility category only. Do not automatically mark any course as approved or completed.

gradeFormula.note: Weight each of two core grades 2, each of four specialization lecture grades 1, each elective grade 1, and the thesis grade 4; divide by 12 plus the number of electives. Do not ECTS-weight graduation grades. Seminar and case studies do not enter this grade formula. Source guidelines Section 3.3, printed page 10.

coreExclusions.note: Advanced Machine Learning and Probabilistic Artificial Intelligence cannot both be recognised as MSc CSE Core Courses; the other may be used in another permitted category. Guidelines Section 3.4, printed page 11.
